For the first time since the Giants started representing New York in the National
Football League a band has been organized to help round out your day's enjoyment.
Under the direction of Russell Wooding this 50 piece band which you will see play
and maneuver today has been drilling for more than a month.
It is the hope of the Giants' management that this band will be as outstanding as
the team has been on the field.
To achieve that aim improvements will continue to
be made as the season progresses.

swing march which will be played this afternoon.
